hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; git fetch --quiet origin 2>/dev/null; B=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..@{u} 2>/dev/null || echo 0); A=$(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); BR=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); jq -nc --arg s "git: branch '$BR' is $B commit(s) behind origin and $A ahead (fetched at session start). If behind > 0, run 'git pull --ff-only' before reasoning about repo state or starting work — other agents push to this repo continuously." '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$s}}'
